title: Design and build a simple planning UI for Planus Manus
description: Programme for the local planning workspace served by pman serve. Direction (owner decision 2026-11-07): look and feel close to Jira (projects page, project sidebar with Summary/Board/List/Documents/Design, KEY-n ticket keys, lozenges, type and priority icons), multi-project from any directory, English UI. Work happens in small visible slices that are checked in the browser; docs/ui-review.md records reviews and fixes. Earlier constraints that still hold: loopback only, CSRF/Host/Origin checks, fixed default port 4000 with a clear error when it is taken.
